models.title: Modular virtual diagnostic: frozen image encoders, PCA fits and camera-1 decoder
models.description: Inference-only Camera-1, TopView and Gaia encoders, the separate Camera-1 decoder, frozen FROG/OAP PCA fits, and the Gaia calibration mask. Includes normalization and provenance. The upstream NVIDIA Kumo weights are linked separately and are not redistributed.

context.title: Modular virtual diagnostic: frozen 2152-row Kumo context and prepared example
context.description: Frozen context of 2152 aligned rows with 88 numerical input features and 21 target coordinates. Targets are 20 Camera-1 image latents plus ICT charge in pC. Includes original row indices, one prepared validation query, and the 285-coordinate image energy axis; no raw images or test rows are included.

split.policy: Random 70/15/15 within each scan; seed 20261005 plus scan number; assignment before quality exclusions; exact cross-partition duplicates quarantined.

provenance.context_rows: Training partition only; original row identities retained in train_indices.
provenance.query: First validation feature vector from the prior packaged example.
provenance.encoders: Camera-1 residual z20; baseline TopView z16; October fine-tuned Gaia z14 with frozen September normalization; refreshed October FROG/OAP PCA8.
provenance.selection: Encoders selected with validation metrics; frozen training-only PCA fits. Source encoder normalizations and state dictionaries preserved.
provenance.extraction: Neural state_dict prefixes selected for encode/decode only; optimizer state and training images omitted. SHA-256 links identify original checkpoints.
provenance.evaluation: No test-set evaluation in this integration; saved validation queries used for Kumo regression checks.
